label: Transfer Wizard
description: Transfer LAMBDA definitions, cell styles, named data ranges, sheet data and Excel tables. Sheet/table transfer copies values and formatting, without VBA.

label: Create Backup
description: Save a timestamped copy to the backup folder configured in Settings. The result displays its full path and an Open Folder button.

label: Dated Version
description: Create a timestamped copy in the original folder. Open and verify the copy before closing and deleting the original; keep the original if verification fails.

label: Save PDF
description: Save PDF using Select Range or Active Sheet. Select Range always opens Excel's range picker instead of automatically exporting the selection. Choose automatic, portrait or landscape.

label: Folder Contents
description: List files with hyperlinks, local paths, extensions, types, readable sizes and creation/modification dates. Choose current-folder or recursive scanning; large folder trees take longer.

label: Combine CSV Files
description: Append CSV files from a folder to one sheet. Keep the first file's header and skip header rows in subsequent files.

label: Combine Sheets
description: Append used ranges from worksheets in the active workbook and add the source worksheet name to the results.

label: Combine Tables
description: Combine rows from selected Excel tables with matching structures into one result table.

label: Smart Append
description: Append worksheets by matching header names, even when column order differs. Missing columns remain blank. Add the source sheet name and preserve the source worksheets.

label: Collect Files
description: Read the first data sheet from Excel/CSV files in a folder and append matching headers. Add the source filename without changing source files.

label: Join by Key
description: Match two datasets using selected key columns. Check key types, spaces and duplicates before choosing the fields to include.

label: Group and Summarize
description: Group records by one or more key columns and summarize selected numeric fields. Specify column numbers or header names.

label: Unpivot
description: Convert wide columns into field/value rows. Keep text headers such as 2026.01 as text.

label: Split Data
description: Split values or datasets using the options shown in the dialog. Choose the source columns and desired output.

label: Split to Files
description: Create separate files for distinct values in a selected column. Choose the destination folder and preserve the source data.

label: Extract URL
description: Extract URL query parameters into separate columns for analysis.

label: Split Pivot
description: Export separate PivotTable filter results to worksheets. Select a cell within the PivotTable first.

label: Pivot
description: Build a cross-tab by moving row categories into columns and summarizing values.

label: Fill Down Blanks
description: Fill blank cells with the nearest nonblank value above in the same column. Useful for repeated group labels in reports.

label: Merge Duplicate Records
description: Merge records by one or more key columns, sum selected numeric fields, keep the first nonblank value in other fields and include a record count.

label: Clean Headers
description: Clean spaces and normalize column headings to a consistent naming scheme.

label: Convert Types
description: Convert selected columns to the requested data types. Review mixed values and conversion errors.

label: Select Columns
description: Select columns by header names or positions such as 1,2,3 within the selected data. Whole-column sources are trimmed to populated rows.

label: Filter Rows
description: Create an output table containing rows that satisfy the chosen column condition. Source data remains unchanged.

label: Sample Data
description: Create a sample of records using the requested sample size or selection options.

label: Shuffle Rows
description: Randomize the order of data rows while preserving values within each row.

label: Compare Lists
description: Compare values in two lists and report matches and differences.

label: Unique List
description: Create a list of distinct values in a selected destination range or on a new worksheet. Configure the default destination behavior in Settings.

label: Data Profile
description: Summarize the contents and data types of selected columns to help assess a dataset.

label: Quality Report
description: Inspect missing values, duplicates and data consistency. Review the report before deciding how to clean the source data.

label: Find Missing
description: Find missing combinations of selected category columns.

label: Trim and Clean
description: Clean redundant spaces and invisible characters while preserving Turkish characters.

label: Change Case
description: Choose uppercase, lowercase or title case from a simple selection dialog.

label: Find by Regular Expression
description: Find text matching a regular-expression pattern and highlight matching cells. Use a preset or a custom pattern.

label: Replace by Regular Expression
description: Replace matching text using a regular expression. Capture groups and references such as $1 can be used.

label: Extract Digits
description: Extract numeric characters from selected text values.

label: Convert Text Numbers
description: Convert suitable numbers stored as text to numeric values. Review decimal and thousands separators.

label: Mask Data
description: Mask selected text according to the available options. Keep an original copy when required.

label: Formulas to Values
description: Replace selected formulas with their current calculated results.

label: Unmerge and Fill
description: Unmerge cells and fill the resulting area with the original merged value.

label: Number and Date Format
description: Apply integer number formatting or standard date formatting. Formatting controls display and does not automatically repair data types.

label: Delete Blanks
description: Delete empty cells and shift remaining cells upward. Check related columns before changing their alignment.

label: Remove Old Dropdown Objects
description: Remove old worksheet dropdown objects while preserving cell data-validation lists.

label: Stripe Rows
description: Apply alternating row colors to the selected area.

label: Date Picker
description: Choose a date and write it to the previously selected active cell. Select month/year and see the distance from today.

label: Fix Dates
description: Normalize suitable date values and review values that cannot be converted.

label: Check Dates
description: Inspect date values for invalid or inconsistent entries.

label: Build Dates
description: Create dates from separate year, month and day fields.

label: Sheet Index
description: Create a worksheet index with hyperlinks to the workbook's sheets.

label: Sort Sheets
description: Sort worksheet tabs alphabetically.

label: Show Hidden Items
description: Reveal hidden sheets, rows or columns as supported by the command.

label: Dynamic Validation List
description: Create list validation using a named range, Table[Column], direct range or spilled range such as A1#. Table/spill sources can expand dynamically.

label: Save Image
description: Save the selected range as PNG, JPG or GIF. Reject oversized images and clean up the temporary chart.

label: Batch Photos
description: Insert supported images from a folder into cells or over cells. In-cell conversion depends on Excel version support; over-cell images are constrained to cell bounds.

label: QR and Barcode
description: Select QR Code or Barcode in one form; model choices follow the type. Supports text, links, email, phone, single values or a batch column. Batch codes go in empty cells to the right. Internet required; at most 250 codes.

label: Compare Sheets
description: Compare worksheets and identify differences.

label: Problem Cells
description: Highlight cells with the problems selected in the dialog.

label: Highlight Cell Types
description: Highlight cells matching a selected type or criterion.

label: Highlight Duplicates
description: Highlight repeated values within the selected area.

label: Write Duplicate Counts
description: Count occurrences of each input value and write the counts to a separately selected output range. A single output cell defines the starting point.

label: List External Links
description: List external Excel workbook links on a new worksheet.

label: Break External Links
description: Break external Excel links. Linked formulas may become values; back up the workbook before proceeding.

label: Help
description: Open the usage guide with workflows, selection/output explanations, limitations and the complete tool catalog.

label: About
description: Show HAMU Tools V1, Hüseyin Avni UZUN and the website, GitHub and email links.

label: AutoFit
description: Adjust column widths and row heights to content; this does not extend table data.

label: Create Table
description: Create an Excel table from a header/data range and apply a consistent table style. A single selected cell uses its current data region.

label: Expand Table
description: Extend the active Excel table into adjacent data. Select a cell inside an existing table first.

label: Worksheet Functions
description: Show the eight HAMU worksheet functions with examples. Function names remain unchanged when switching language.

label: HAMU_URLCoz
description: =HAMU_URLCoz(A1) | Decode UTF-8 URL characters; preserve invalid percent sequences.

label: HAMU_RengeGoreTopla
description: =HAMU_RengeGoreTopla(A1:A20;B1) | Sum numbers with the same direct fill color as B1. Recalculate with F9 after changing formatting.

label: HAMU_RengeGoreSay
description: =HAMU_RengeGoreSay(A1:A20;B1) | Count cells with the same direct fill color as B1. Recalculate with F9 after changing formatting.

label: HAMU_YerelDosyaYolu
description: =HAMU_YerelDosyaYolu(A1) | Map a personal OneDrive URL to a local path using the local OneDrive environment variable; preserve other URL types.

label: HAMU_GizliLink
description: =HAMU_GizliLink(A1) | Return the first hyperlink address in the cell.

label: HAMU_LinkParamDegeri
description: =HAMU_LinkParamDegeri(A1;"id") | Return the value of the specified URL query parameter.

label: HAMU_SayidanMetine
description: =HAMU_SayidanMetine(123) | Spell numbers in Turkish. Supports absolute values below 15 digits and reads decimal digits individually. The output language stays Turkish.

label: HAMU_TablodanVeriGetir
description: =HAMU_TablodanVeriGetir(A1;"Tablo1";"Kod";"Ad") | Return the first matching value from a table in the workbook containing the formula.

label: Count by Color
description: Count cells matching the sample cell's displayed fill color, including conditional formatting.

label: Sum by Color
description: Sum numeric values matching the sample cell's displayed fill color, including conditional formatting. Ignore blank, text and error values.

label: Fill Blanks with Zero
description: Write zero only to genuinely empty cells. Preserve populated cells and formulas returning empty text.

label: Add Prefix or Suffix
description: Add text before or after values and write to a separate output range. Preserve the source and leading zeros.

label: Leading Zeros
description: Add or remove leading zeros from text codes. Preserve source values and write the result as text.

label: Deduplicate Cell Items
description: Remove repeated items within each cell using the chosen separator, keeping their first occurrence.

label: Extract Text Part
description: Extract characters from the left/right or text before, after or between specified markers.

label: Date List
description: Generate dates between a start and end date, optionally excluding weekends. Choose the output start cell.

label: Formula Audit
description: List formulas, source-cell links, displayed results, errors and direct external workbook references on a new sheet. Source formulas remain unchanged.

label: Select Special Cells
description: Select formulas, constants, errors, blanks or visible cells within the current area. Do not change values or formatting.

label: List Defined Names
description: List workbook/worksheet names, references, visibility and broken references on a new sheet without modifying the names.

label: Data Entry
description: Open Excel's native data form for the current table or contiguous list with unique headers; at most 32 columns.

label: Clear Highlights
description: Remove HAMU highlights in the selection. Restore prior fills in the same session; older highlights are recognized by their yellow/orange palette.

label: HAMU_L_CokluAra
description: Exact lookup across two key/result pairs, returning the first match. Example: =HAMU_L_CokluAra(G2;A2:A10;B2:B10;D2:D10;E2:E10). Transfer it from the LAMBDA template; Microsoft 365/Excel 2024 required.

label: HAMU_L_CokluTopla
description: Sum matching values across two key/value pairs. Example: =HAMU_L_CokluTopla(G2;A2:A10;B2:B10;D2:D10;E2:E10). Transfer from the template; Microsoft 365/Excel 2024 required.

label: HAMU_L_BenzersizBirlestir
description: Combine nonblank values from two areas into a sorted unique list. Example: =HAMU_L_BenzersizBirlestir(A2:B10;D2:E10). Requires a blank spill area and Microsoft 365/Excel 2024.

label: Save Copy
description: Save a copy at a chosen location, preserving the open workbook identity, unsaved state, file format and macros.
